terms: 招標文件支付條款 Tender Document Payment Terms - Stage Payment Plan -相等於樓價 5%之訂金於投標書獲賣方接納當日(即接納書的日期)繳付 - A deposit equivalent to 5% of the purchase price shall be paid upon the tender being accepted by the Vendor (i.e. the date of the Letter of Acceptance). - 在收到賣方接納投標的書面通知的90日内，一張或多張由香港持牌銀行發出金額合 共等於出價95%的港幣銀行本票及/或支票 。 - one or more Hong Kong dollar cashier orders and/or cheque issued by a licensed bank in Hong Kong in the amount of 95% of the purchase price offered, to be paid within 90 days of receiving a written notice of acceptance.
